slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice

caption:
Momo is always the bendiest in class. Deep stretches feel great, then her joints ache.

Some people's joints move further than average. That isn't a problem on its own, but muscles may have to work harder to control that range, which can lead to aches. Bendy isn't the same as strong.

Hybi's control practice: park the deep end-range stretches and work in the middle of your range. Go slow, use lighter springs and smaller movements, and notice which muscles are working. Add load bit by bit. Research suggests strength training helps many very flexible people.

Joints that often partly slip, widespread aches or unusual tiredness are worth an assessment. The Pilates team at Hybrid Physio builds programs around control. Book online via the link in bio 🐱
